writable_path: derive inputHash from current dependency trace
try input-to-output mapping, then compatible saved-trace outputs
on cache hit, restore only when explicit restore or restoreAllArtifacts requests it
otherwise accept/build local output according to saved-trace status
when status is cacheable, publish content-addressed artifact
publish current artifact trace to caller
readonly_path: first accept an up-to-date local output
if local output is not reusable and cache reads are enabled, resolve cache/trace output
restore a cache hit into the conventional local target path
otherwise build locally without artifact-cache publication

artifact_publication.text: normalize CRLF to LF, hash normalized text, create-if-absent cache file
artifact_publication.binary: hash bytes, prefer hard link, otherwise create-if-absent byte write
artifact_publication.existing_path: accepted without rehash in the inspected local path
artifact_publication.race_property: same-path artifact creation explicitly tolerates another creator winning

mapping_publication.invalid_json_read_behavior: warn and treat as no mapping

restoration.existing_destination: leave it in place and return it as preferred artifact path
restoration.missing_destination: hard-link cached artifact; copy on hard-link failure; write local hash sidecar
restoration.nonwritable_readable_default: restore cache hit to local target path

partial_state_recovery.direct_mapping_write_failure: propagates as error after artifact may already be published
